type T = [...([number] | [string, string])];
const invalid: T = [1, 2];
const wrongLength: T = ['a'];
type W<A extends readonly unknown[]> = readonly [0, ...A, 1];
const mixed: W<[number] | [string, string]> = [0, 'x', 2, 1];
function apply(...args: T): void { console.log(args); }
apply(1,2);
apply();
apply('x');
const readonlyValue: W<[number] | [string, string]> = [0, 1, 1];
readonlyValue[0] = 0;
const impossible: [...never] = [];
type Many<T extends readonly unknown[]> =
  [...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T, ...T];
type OverLimit = Many<[0] | [1]>;
